# AZ Dental Club

> AZ Dental Club is a comprehensive dental practice in Phoenix, Arizona serving 20,000+ patients with advanced preventive, restorative, cosmetic, and surgical dental services.

Led by Dr. Jason H Nordean and a team of experienced dentists, AZ Dental Club operates across Phoenix, Tempe, Scottsdale, and Glendale with state-of-the-art technology including 3D cone beam imaging, digital treatment planning, and laser diagnostics. The practice specializes in family dentistry, orthodontics, dental implants, and cosmetic procedures.

## Core Dental Services

- [Dental Services Overview](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services): Main dental services overview by Dr. Jason Nordean including Invisalign and family care
- [General Dentistry](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services/general-dentistry): General dentistry services: cleanings, exams, fillings, preventive care, new patients
- [Emergency Dental Care](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services/emergency-dental-care): Emergency dental care: same-day appointments for tooth pain, trauma, broken teeth
- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services/pediatric-dentistry): Pediatric dentistry: preventive care, early intervention in child-friendly environment

## Orthodontics & Teeth Straightening

- [Orthodontics](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services/othodontics): Orthodontic services: metal braces, ceramic braces, clear aligner therapy
- [Invisalign Clear Aligners](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services/invisalign-clear-aligners): Invisalign clear aligners with 3D digital treatment planning for discreet teeth straightening

## Restorative & Replacement Dentistry

- [Dental Implants](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services/dental-implants): Dental implants: titanium implants with osseointegration, All-on-4, All-on-6 options
- [Root Canal Treatment](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services/rootcanaltreatment): Root canal treatment with 3D cone beam CT imaging and advanced endodontic techniques
- [Crown & Bridge](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services/crown-bridge): Dental crowns and bridges in porcelain, ceramic, zirconia for tooth restoration
- [Dentures & Removable Prosthetics](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services/dentures-removable-prosthetics): Dentures and removable prosthetics: complete, partial, implant-supported, repairs
- [Caries Cleaning & Restoration](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services/caries-cleaning-restoration): Cavity treatment and restoration with laser caries detection and air abrasion technology

## Cosmetic & Esthetic Dentistry

- [Esthetic Dentistry](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services/esthetic-dentistry): Cosmetic dentistry: teeth whitening, porcelain veneers, cosmetic bonding services
- [Composite Bonding](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services/bonding): Composite bonding: repair chips, cracks, gaps with tooth-colored resin

## Preventive & Periodontal Care

- [Cleaning, Scaling and Root Planning](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services/cleaning-scaling-and-root-planning): Gum disease treatment: scaling, root planing for gingivitis and periodontitis
- [Dental Sealants](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services/dental-sealants): Dental sealants for cavity prevention on molars, especially for pediatric patients
- [Fluoride Treatments](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services/fluoride-treatments): Fluoride treatments: varnish, gel, foam for enamel strengthening and cavity prevention

## Oral Surgery

- [Minor Oral Surgery](https://azdentalclub.com/dental-services/oral-surgery): Oral surgery: extractions, wisdom teeth removal with nitrous oxide and IV sedation
